title: Shipping Oil At Your Own Risk
section_path: Shipping Oil At Your Own Risk
section_path_text: Shipping Oil At Your Own Risk
summary:
The EU and UK plan to block insurance for Russian oil cargoes
The EU is expected to announce a new set of sanctions aimed at eliminating all seaborne movements of Russian oil to Europe. To convince EU member Hungary to go along with the new measures, pipeline exports are to be excluded. However, since more than two-thirds of the European imports of oil are seaborne, these actions will likely have a significant impact.
